records.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1078: Initializing destinationCalendar to null when the organizer and event type lack one causes optional push calls to discard all collective cohost calendars.
records.rationale: The diff sets `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when neither eventType nor organizerUser has one, then later does `if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE") { evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars); }`. Optional chaining means when the base value is null, cohost destination calendars collected in teamDestinationCalendars are silently dropped, so collective events lose team members' calendars even when those members have them. This is a verifiable mechanism introduced by this diff.
